corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward must deliver lethal artillery damage before it threatens detained civilians or reaches its exit. Already-born projectiles remain live after source death.
Fang blocks upper-central traffic. Spot can heal him during skill windows; Midnight may assist from range only when not committed to a blocked lower-outer enemy. Actual armor contact is required.
Spot blocks the lower central corridor. Fang's forward assistance and Midnight's downward arts window supply damage while Spot heals. Three-block capacity is finite.
Plume blocks and damages upper-outer enemies, receiving ordinary Hibiscus healing.
Midnight blocks the lower outer corridor and clears its restraint. His lack of medical coverage must be assessed as a survival limitation; no regeneration or civilian healing is assumed.

Destroy eastern restraints through ordinary supported attacks, protect civilians from unblocked officers, then destroy both western restraints in the final rotation. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central blocking, conditional assistance to the lower central corridor, and automatic deployment income.
Three-block lower-central containment and intermittent healing of Fang, self and Ansel.
Upper-outer interception and eastern upper restraint destruction.
Lower-outer interception, eastern lower restraint destruction through the lateral range cell, and central assistance when unblocked.
Central and caster healing from a position diagonally separated from the lower blocker.
Upper-corridor healing and additional medical service to Steward.
Artillery clearance across the eastern vertical route.

artillery_damage_budget.geometry: [2,7] UP includes the artillery's eastern column from row 2 through the row-5 tip.
artillery_damage_budget.limitation: Coverage does not establish 45 delivered artillery hits. Target acquisition, attack timing, injury, death and central-target competition must be observed.
artillery_damage_budget.sufficient_hit_example: 45 Steward hits including nine enhanced hits produce 13227.21 damage using 470*1.06 ATK and 50 RES.

economy.conditions: The ledger requires Fang to remain alive and deployed through all three opening grants. Death grants no retreat refund. Current inspected runtime charges the catalog deployment cost again and enforces the actual redeployment timer.

medical_geometry.midnight: Neither physician nor Spot covers Midnight at [6,5] in this formation. His endurance is an explicit unresolved limitation, not credited healing.

formation_structure.opening_survival: Fang initially fights the first runner without cross-assistance. At the supplied stats, sixteen ordinary hits are required and eleven incoming strikes leave only 5 HP. Attack ordering therefore matters; Spot's first healing is a recovery handoff rather than proof that this duel is safe.
formation_structure.validation: Read-only catalog and range inspection only. No stage simulation was run. Static geometry identifies material survival gaps; full-stage acceptance is not established.

formation_transitions.transition: Install the lower-central guardian before its first runner arrives.
Spot changes from damage to healing, recovering Fang and retaining lower blocking.
Complete four corridor interceptions and assign both eastern restraints to outer holders.
Renew guardian healing during the first upper artillery exposure.
Renew guardian support for the later artillery and central-pressure interval.
Scheduled hostile-clearance handoff to the remaining central formation before outer-holder withdrawal.
Redeploy both outer holders west after their seventy-second cooldowns.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the seven listed normal-mode rarity-1-to-3 IDs may be deployed. No aliases or reserve units.
Fang must survive the first runner and receive recovery before further officer pressure. Missing DP after his death is a survival failure.
Skill availability and aggregate HPS do not prove survival. Inspect actual heals between impacts, including Ansel's initially unsupported lower exposure.
Do not invent healing for Midnight. If accumulated injury removes him before lower-outer clearance, the selected fixed continuation fails.
Zero leaks, zero civilian deaths and two observed safe arrivals are required. Eastern restraint clearance alone does not establish safety.
Skills and retreats require a currently deployed operator. Unexpected death invalidates that operator's later fixed commands rather than granting a free replacement.
The scheduled outer withdrawals require prior hostile clearance and resolved projectile danger. Failure of that prerequisite invalidates the scheduled rotation.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two protected-target arrivals.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Win the narrow opening duel, establish four interceptions, obtain actual Fang income, and install both physicians.

Separate splash where geometry permits, clear eastern restraints, and establish Steward's artillery contact. Ansel's first lower exposure remains an unresolved survival risk because Spot's opening skill has ended.
Deliver healing to actual injured recipients, finish artillery, protect both detained civilians, and preserve central blocking. Midnight's accumulated injury is independently decisive.
Intercept every late runner and armor unit, use Midnight's arts window where it has actual contact, and clear residual hostiles before withdrawing outer holders.
Complete legal cooldowns, destroy western restraints and observe two safe arrivals. The final frame is an observation horizon, not an automatic victory declaration.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP only while alive and deployed; no manual skill command.
Supported healing mode retains blocking and stops attacks. Each repeat allows twenty-five active seconds followed by forty inactive seconds.
Increase physical clearance on the upper outer corridor. No kill-DP talent is credited.
Use supported arts conversion for blocked officers and central ground enemies in range. Current runtime does not allow this melee operator to attack the flying artillery.
Increase single-target healing and extend forward coverage. No extra-heal talent, guaranteed recipient or attack-clock reset is assumed.
Increase healing during artillery exposure and late pressure without assuming favorable equal-ratio selection.
Automatic enhanced arts attacks and supported high-defense priority. Count damage delivered to artillery rather than nominal contact time.

tactical_thesis: Replace the second pioneer with Midnight and the second caster with Hibiscus. Put Spot on the lower central corridor, give both outer corridors operators that can attack their eastern restraints, and move Steward to [2,7] facing UP for longer artillery contact. This is a complete CURRENT_MODEL_CHECKABLE experimental plan, not a verified winning plan. Its decisive unresolved dependencies are the opening Fang duel, delivered healing during artillery exposure, and Midnight's unhealed lower-outer endurance. Failure of any dependency invalidates the continuation.
